backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with all platform types, branding state, user data structures, and maps for tutorials, posts, products, orders, and profiles.
backend/token.mo: Implements a token system with balances, transaction histories, and functions for minting, transferring, spending, and querying tokens.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature‑removal evidence mapping features to frontend files, related components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of various frontend files.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell that loads the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing, theming, identity initialization, and profile‑setup modal logic for the frontend app.
frontend/src/components/AddProductDialog: Dialog for creating new products, including image uploads, validation, and submission to backend hooks.
frontend/src/components/AddTutorialDialo: Dialog for creating a tutorial with title, description, difficulty, and video upload or selection, handling media uploads and form submission.
frontend/src/components/admin/BrandingSe: Admin UI for editing site branding including name, slogan, logo, and icon, with file upload, previews, and save/cancel handling.
frontend/src/components/admin/HeroSettin: Admin panel for updating hero section text and image, supporting image upload with progress and saving updated settings.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrdersSect: Displays all orders for admins with status, payment type, items summary, and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/admin/PageSettin: Admin interface for editing page titles, subtitles, and banner images for multiple pages, including uploads and change tracking.
frontend/src/components/admin/PaymentSet: Admin UI for viewing and updating Stripe test/live keys and switching active mode with validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/AIAssistantPanel: Empty placeholder file intended for the removed AI assistant panel component.
frontend/src/components/AIChatTutor.tsx: Empty placeholder file intended for the removed AI chat tutor component.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Drawer showing cart items, totals, and checkout via Stripe or tokens with validation and purchase order saving.
frontend/src/components/checkout/BuyerDe: Renders name, phone, and notes input fields with validation messages for checkout.
frontend/src/components/checkout/StripeC: Handles buyer details validation, token-based discounts, checkout session creation, and redirecting to Stripe.
frontend/src/components/DepositICPDialog: Empty or placeholder file with no content provided.
frontend/src/components/EditProductDialo: Dialog for editing a product’s details and images, including image upload, reordering, and removal before saving changes.
frontend/src/components/ExternalBlobImag: Component that displays an image from an ExternalBlob with loading and error fallbacks.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main site layout with navigation, authentication handling, branding, favicon updates, and cart indicators.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Simple loading screen with an icon and message.
frontend/src/components/MediaLibraryMana: Interface for uploading, listing, and deleting video media files with admin and uploader permissions.
frontend/src/components/MintTokensDialog: A dialog for admins to mint tokens by entering a recipient principal, amount, and optional description, using a mintTokens mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal that collects username and bio to create and save a new user profile using the saveProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/RestoreProductsD: A dialog that restores predefined product templates by uploading associated images and creating products via mutations.
frontend/src/components/SendTokensDialog: A dialog allowing users to transfer tokens by specifying a recipient principal, amount, and description, with balance validation.
frontend/src/components/ShareRecordingDi: A dialog for uploading an audio/video file and creating a community post with title and description after media upload.
frontend/src/components/StripeConfigDial: A legacy Stripe configuration dialog for setting secret keys and allowed countries, showing existing config when available.
frontend/src/components/WorkWithUsDialog: A dialog form that collects name, email, and message, validates inputs, and submits a Work With Us application via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/config/appBuildInfo.ts: Provides helpers to read build metadata from env variables and format version/environment info.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of react-query hooks for backend operations like user profiles, branding, media, admin checks, and Stripe.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and component colors.
frontend/src/lib/cartStore.ts: Zustand store managing cart items with add, update, remove, clear, and count operations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard handling identity, permission checks, and navigation between admin management tabs.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityPage.tsx: Displays community posts with banner, share dialog, and conditional admin/auth features.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page showing hero section, features, and featured tutorials and products.
frontend/src/pages/LearningPage.tsx: Tutorial browsing page with difficulty filters, banner settings, and authentication-aware actions.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure screen explaining the error and offering navigation options after checkout reset.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Verifies Stripe session, creates a purchase order, clears cart/context, updates queries, and handles success or failure redirects.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the logged-in user's profile, token balance, uploaded content count, and purchased content.
frontend/src/pages/StorePage.tsx: Shows product catalog with admin management, cart functions, product CRUD dialogs, and list refreshing.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Shows the user's token wallet, transaction history, and send-token dialog.
frontend/src/types.ts: Defines shared TypeScript interfaces and enums for roles, tutorials, posts, settings, AI interactions, and token transactions.
frontend/src/utils/stripeCheckoutContext: Saves, loads, and clears checkout context in sessionStorage with expiration handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom color tokens, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project's current state, including existing features to remove AI-related UI and the community page button, along with pending feature requests.
